title: W21 Mac references: the find bar (Ctrl+F / ⌘F)
about: Uses the test-safe find hooks from #384 (merged; safety-reviewed): KITE_TEST_FIND (open the find bar and set its text once the first page loads; Ask on Page forced off) and KITE_TEST_FIND_OPEN (the same, empty). The script allowance is #388, carried on this request branch. Note: a WebKit build reports only found/not found, so find-matches shows no 1/2 counter there; only a CEF build shows counts. Session: windows/helix/states/find-bar.json from helix/W21-find (sidebar.json with pageAppearance light), the selected tab https://example.com/, which has two matches for "domain". The Windows captures are Kite.exe --capture --window-size 1280,820 --capture-scale 2 --find "" | --find domain --find-result 1/2 | --find zqxj --find-result 0/0 on the same session.

states.name: find-empty
states.holds: the find bar open and empty over example.com, 10pt in from the content card's top-right corner: the magnifier, "Find in page…", the arrows, the divider and close; no counter

states.name: find-matches
states.holds: the find bar with "domain" typed and the counter reading 1/2, the first match highlighted on the page

states.name: find-none
states.holds: the find bar with "zqxj" typed and "Not Found" in red where the counter goes
